comments: Information of tracklisting from Hal C F Astell's website.
Live concert from the archives: Y+T from the Reading Festival, 1982.
In response to a listener asking whether the BBC had recorded any of the Donington concerts the previous year, Tommy regrets that ZZ Top did not give permission and so this did not happen.
